A talk shows once by itself (s.seen[key]); a button brings it back. `who` is a PEOPLE region, a WORKSHOPS id or 'tutor' (your class's Guild tutor); `show` are item icons shown large; {numbers} are filled in by the game.

quarry.title: Ranger Ash: know your quarry
lines: "Ten chickens -- good. Now you know something about them you didn't this morning. That's what the Bestiary is: your Library keeps one, and it fills in by itself as you hunt."

"Beat ten of anything and you'll know where to hit it. Fifty, and what it shrugs off. A hundred and fifty, and which elements it fears -- fire, water, earth or wind. In a fight, look at its card: what you know shows there."

"And for the patient --" he turns a golden feather in the light -- "beat enough of one kind, and it's mastered: you hit it harder, it drops more, and some creatures give you something of their own. A chicken gives this. About nine hundred and sixty of them, mind. Every creature has its number."

hobb.title: Sexton Hobb: about life essence
lines: "Life essence, that's what you're after. It's what brings a lost pet back -- a Necromancer raises a pet from its grave with it, at the Graveyard on your Estate."
"The wisps carry it. They only come out at night, down here, and only one in eight leaves any behind. That's the honest way to get it."

"For them as can't wait, I keep a little: {price} coins a piece, and no more than {daily} a day -- come back tomorrow for the rest. How much does a pet need? Its battle level divided by five, rounded up -- a level-30 pet takes six -- and half as much again every time it's raised after."

talents.title: Your talent tree
lines: "Every two class levels you earn a talent point. Spend it on a badge in one of your three branches -- the tree's yours to shape."

"A branch opens a row at a time: the badges further down need points spent higher up the same branch first, and some follow the one above them (the line between them shows it). Until then they're dim -- locked."

"The big gold badges at the bottom are keystones: one point, a big change. A dashed ring means one of two -- take either, not both. Changed your mind? Respec is free up to class level {free}; after that it costs a little."
